name: 39426 · Carriere, MS
findings: ZIP 39426 (Carriere) has 22 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 6 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 39426 (Carriere) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
